sloka: प्रत्यगारमिवायान्ती वत्सला वत्सकारणात् ।बद्धवत्सा यथा धेनू राममाताभ्याधावत ॥२-४०-४३॥
transliteration: pratyagāramivāyāntī vatsalā vatsakāraṇāt ।baddhavatsā yathā dhenū rāmamātābhyādhāvata ॥2-40-43॥

translations.english: Rama's mother ran after the chariot, like an affectionate cow running towards the shed to join its fastened calf.
